publicChrome.footerHeadline: Ubuhlakani bokuthengwa kwempahla yomphakathi, bubhalwe ngokucacile
publicChrome.footerBody: Ulwazi olusesidlangalaleni lwabahlinzeki, abathengi, abalingani bokulinga kanye nababambe iqhaza ekuthengeni. Amakhasi ezomthetho nawenqubomgomo aqukethe ulimi lwesimeli sochwepheshe futhi akuzona iseluleko sokugcina sezomthetho.

home.headline: Lapho Abahlinzeki be-SA Behlangana Nokuthengwa Kwangempela.
home.intro: Phequlula amathenda asesidlangalaleni ahlolwe ngokuzenzakalela kanye nama-RFQ ngemboni, isifundazwe kanye nedethi yokuvala—ngezixhumanisi zemithombo yoqobo.
home.sourceNote: Amathuba omphakathi atholakala ohlwini olusemthethweni lokuthenga.
home.supplierBody: Thola amathuba. Qinisekisa. Khulisa ibhizinisi lakho.
home.smartScoreBody: Yakhiwe ngobufakazi bokuthobela obubuyekeziwe kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwebhange.
home.buyerBody: Abahlinzeki abaqinisekisiwe ngumthombo. Thumela i-RFQ. Phatha izingcaphuno.
home.trackedDaily: Ukuthengwa kwempahla yomphakathi, okulandelwa nsuku zonke
home.statsBody: Amathuba amanje avela kuma-eTender kahulumeni asemthethweni, ahlolelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo izaziso ezikhanseliwe noma esezinikeziwe kakade.
home.network: Inethiwekhi yokuthengwa kwempahla eNingizimu Afrika ibisilindile.
home.supplierPoint1: Faka ohlwini ibhizinisi lakho. Layisha inombolo yakho ye-CSD nesitifiketi se-B-BBEE.
home.supplierPoint2: Thola i-SmartScore—isilinganiso sakho sokwethenjwa, sibonakala kuwo wonke umthengi.
home.supplierPoint3: Ama-RFQ afanayo eza kuwe. Azisekho izinsuku zokuvala eziphuthelwe.
home.verified48: Kuqinisekiswe emahoreni angama-48. Alikho ikhadi lesikweletu.
home.smartScoreIntro: Wonke umphakeli uphethe i-SmartScore—ihlolwa emithonjeni emine esemthethweni yaseNingizimu Afrika, ebuyekezwa ithimba lethu.
home.smartScoreRank: Amaphuzu angama-90 noma ngaphezulu futhi iphrofayela yakho ihlala kuqala ekusesheni komthengi.
home.buyerPoint1: Thumela i-RFQ ngemizuzu emihlanu. Setha imfuneko yakho ye-B-BBEE, isifundazwe, nobubanzi benani.
home.buyerPoint3: Qhathanisa izingcaphuno ngapha nangapha—ngayinye iphethe i-SmartScore nebheji yokuqinisekisa.
home.trustOfficialBody: I-CSD, SARS, CIPC nobufakazi basebhange—bubuyekezwe ithimba lethu ngaphambi kokuba kuvele noma yimuphi umphakeli.
home.trustMatchingBody: Amathuba avulekile afaniswa namaphrofayili abahlinzeki ngemboni ebhalisiwe nesifundazwe.
home.trustNotificationsBody: Abahlinzeki bayo bayaziswa kungakapheli imizuzu embalwa yokuthunyelwa kwe-RFQ efanayo.
home.trustAuditBody: Yonke ikhwotheshini, umklomelo, kanye nokwenziwe kufakiwe futhi kuyathekelisa ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthengwa kwempahla.
